description: Puts the built-in registration animation on a registration page: self-running slides from the benefit to the host to the sign-up, either instead of the video or below it. Take it when a page has no video or should show both. A host says: "I have no clip, show the slides instead." It needs the session and the webinar, and the mode, animation or both. Both needs a video on the campaign and is refused without one. It writes on your site, participants see the animation on their next visit, and your stored video stays stored, so switching back to the video restores it exactly. A campaign that renders on several pages needs the page named, or a clear yes for all of them. A page you edited by hand is left alone unless you say so. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: slides instead of video, no clip, animation on the page, both

apply_to_all.description: Change every page the campaign renders on. Only after the host agreed to that.

benefits.description: The benefit lines of the first slide, in the host's words.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

cta_label.description: The label of the sign-up button on the last slide.

headline.description: The headline of the first slide, if the host wants their own.

mode.description: animation replaces the video or image with the animation, both keeps the video and puts the animation below it. Default animation.

overwrite_edited.description: Also change a page whose animation the host edited by hand. Only with page_id and only after asking.

page_id.description: Change only this one page of the campaign.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_registration_animation
title: Put the registration animation on the page
